text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (ferritin, D-dimer, CRP, ALT, INR). There is also mild renal impairment (creatinine high) and mild hypoglycemia. No evidence of acute cardiac injury or COVID-19 infection. Findings suggest a systemic inflammatory response, possibly due to infection or another inflammatory process; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
